## About
Showcase Auto Body is the body shop on Old Camplain Rd in Hillsborough. We do collision repair, vehicle painting and body work, and we can tow your car in if it can't make the trip.
We work with all insurance companies and complete the paperwork for you, so you're not stuck chasing forms after an accident. Consultations are free, and so are second opinions.
When you come in, you'll likely talk with Stan. Our neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 58 Google reviews, and we'd like to keep earning it one car at a time.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Dents, broken glass and paint damage after an accident. We'll tow your car in and get it repaired promptly.
- Vehicle Painting: Repaints with precise color matching, from small paint damage to full repainting after a major collision.
- Vehicle Body Work: A wide range of body work to give your car a fresh look.
- Pinstriping: Customize the look of your car to suit your style.
- Storm and hail: Whether it was a collision, a storm or hail, bring your car in any condition.
- Towing Service: If your car can't be driven after an accident, we can tow it to the shop.
- Fleet accounts: Keep your work vehicles on the road with a fleet account for collision repair and repaint jobs.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with all insurance companies and complete the necessary paperwork for you.

Q: Do you charge for a consultation or second opinion?
A: No. Stop by the shop on Old Camplain Rd for a free consultation or a second opinion.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Schedule online or call us directly at 908-575-9000.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash and personal checks.

Driving home, we passed Showcase, turned around, went in, and spoke with Stan. “No problem, my guys will bend it back into shape. About $250.” Won’t break the window? Nope, they do it all the time and have seen much worse. We dropped the car off that evening and it was fixed by lunchtime the next day. A couple of weeks later, we hit a deer, wrecking the hood, grille, headlight, fender, and side view mirror. Back to Showcase. Stan ordered all the parts, pre-painted everything, and when everything was ready and true to his word , he had the car fixed in two days at the price he quoted us. He also, without charge, took some dents out of a door that had been previously hit by a deer, and touched up the little scratches and dings on the rest of the car. The car looks beautiful, better than it did before we hit the deer. I’d never take a car anywhere else. Thanks guys!" (Chiz Walter, 5/5)
